_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-75 coil base rate demands HOLD as the skilled default — both brains see bullish macro tailwinds but neither has identified the breaker that converts compressed energy into directional expansion.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes — both align on HOLD with bullish macro conditions building, though Narrative leans more optimistic on imminent resolution while Analyst demands explicit confirmation signals before committing.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks $72k with volume expansion and funding stays below 0.05% while DXY breaks below 98.5
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC loses $65k with VIX spiking above 20 and exchange netflow flipping above 60 (inflow surge)
